He has not played an official match since November and pulled out of the ATP Finals citing a shoulder injury, reducing match sharpness.
He is older (38) which raises injury and recovery risk over a two-week Grand Slam; the field includes younger top players (Alcaraz, Sinner, etc.) who have recently captured most majors.
